data.name: THE SIGNAL: Stranded on Sirenis
data.detailed_description:
FOLLOW US

>> Twitter: @TheSignalG

>> Tiktok:  @TheSignalGame

>> Bluesky: @thesignalg.bsky.social‬

>> Facebook: Goose Byte


About the Game

The Signal is a survival crafter like no other. Your desperate search to find a missing loved one has crash-landed you on a planet. You learn this planet is most unusual, and find yourself trapped. Scavenge, build, extract and survive your way through a complex world as you reveal the true intentions of this sentient planet -- and why it has brought you here.

UNRAVEL THE MYSTERY

Can you uncover the unknown forces that power the planet? Will you escape from its clutches? Why did it draw you here in the first place? Explore and discover the signal source, find your lost brother, and get out alive.

EXPLORE AND SURVIVE

To explore and survive on this strange planet, you’ll need to scavenge resources, craft useful items and upgrade your gear. Adapting to various environments requires the proper loadout, so prepare yourself as you investigate the strange ruins and crash sites scattered across the planet. Could there be other survivors here? Survival-craft your way to safety, as you learn about new technologies and resources.

EXTRACT AND ADAPT

Uncover clues about the powerful relationship between the planet and the forces that drive it. Relics with unusual properties will need to be found and returned to their original locations, but restoring balance to this planet is a treacherous task. Every ancient relic you discover can cause unforeseen consequences. Adapt to your surroundings to safely extract the resources and items you need.

RESEARCH AND CUSTOMIZE

Learn about the planet and its inhabitants to expand your arsenal of options. Through research, you’ll uncover more build and craft options, more recipes, more tools, equipment, and weapons.

CUSTOM VEHICLES

You must traverse and plan your travels across multiple worlds, ranging from tranquil glades, dense marsh, scorched rifts, and frozen tundras. Customize your vehicle to improve your chances of safe passage across this treacherous world.

ABOUT GOOSE BYTE

We’re a small team that’s committed to creating worlds and memorable experiences for players. Our studio was founded in Montreal, Canada in September 2021 and became fully independent in July 2023. The Signal is the first game we are making together as a team and we look forward to sharing this sci-fi journey with you.

data.short_description: The Signal: Stranded on Sirenis is a single-player survival craft game set on a captivating alien planet that has ensnared you. Scavenge, build, extract, and survive your way through a complex world as you reveal the true intentions of this sentient planet - and why it has brought you here.

English*, French, German, Japanese, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Spanish - Latin America
*languages with full audio support
data.reviews:
“If you enjoyed the base building in Fallout 4 or the feeling of stepping out onto an unknown world in No Man’s Sky, The Signal is probably worth checking out.”
PCGamesN

Minimum:

  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: i5-3570 3.4 GHz 4 Core
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 770 2GB
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Minimum requirements may change over the course of development.
